n't.def_en: contraction of 'not', attached to an auxiliary or modal verb (as in don't, isn't, can't)

etc.def_en: abbreviation of et cetera: and other similar things; and so on

huh.def_en: an exclamation used to express surprise or confusion, or to ask for something to be repeated

uh.def_en: a sound made when hesitating or pausing in speech

theirs.def_en: used to refer to a thing or things belonging to or associated with people previously mentioned

subscale.def_en: a smaller part of a larger scale, especially one measuring a specific subset in a test or survey

policymaker.def_en: a person responsible for making policy, especially in government or a large organization

um.def_en: a sound made when hesitating or pausing while speaking

hmm.def_en: a sound used to express thinking, hesitation, or doubt

gosh.def_en: a mild exclamation used to express surprise or emphasis

offseason.def_en: the part of the year when a particular sport or activity is not taking place

yep.def_en: an informal way of saying yes

baseman.def_en: a baseball fielder positioned at or near one of the bases

storytelling.def_en: the activity or art of telling or writing stories

groundwater.def_en: water held underground in the soil or in pores and crevices in rock

async.def_en: (computing) short for asynchronous; not happening at the same time or not requiring one task to finish before another starts

bitwise.def_en: (computing) operating on the individual bits of binary data

deque.def_en: (computing) a double-ended queue that allows elements to be added or removed at both ends

deserialize.def_en: (computing) to convert serialized data back into an object or data structure

enum.def_en: (computing) short for enumeration; a data type consisting of a set of named constant values

hashtable.def_en: (computing) a data structure that maps keys to values using a hash function for fast lookup

mutex.def_en: (computing) a mechanism that prevents multiple threads from accessing a shared resource at the same time

polyfill.def_en: (computing) code that implements a feature on web browsers that do not natively support it

rebase.def_en: (computing) to move or reapply a sequence of commits onto a new base commit in version control

regexp.def_en: (computing) short for regular expression; a pattern used to match combinations of characters in text

routing.def_en: the process of selecting a path for traffic in a network, or directing something along a route

set.def_en: to put something in a particular place or position; also, a group of similar things that belong together

struct.def_en: (computing) a composite data type that groups together several variables under a single name

tuple.def_en: (computing and mathematics) an ordered list of elements, often of a fixed length

underflow.def_en: (computing) a condition in which a number is smaller than the smallest value a system can represent
